erasmus_bridge.name: Erasmus Bridge
erasmus_bridge.price_text: Free to walk or cycle across
erasmus_bridge.tip: Walk the full span from Kop van Zuid to the north bank for the best skyline views.

cube_houses.name: Cube Houses
cube_houses.price_text: ≈ €3 for the Kijk-Kubus show house; check on the day
cube_houses.hours: Show house usually daily 10:00–17:00; check on the day
cube_houses.tip: Pay the small fee to see inside one cube — the tilted walls make more sense up close.

markthal.name: Markthal
markthal.price_text: Free to enter; food from a few euros
markthal.hours: Roughly 10:00–20:00 daily; some stalls close earlier on Sunday
markthal.tip: Come hungry and graze the stalls — it is a food hall first, a sight second.

euromast.name: Euromast
euromast.hours: Usually daily 09:30–21:00; check on the day
euromast.tip: Go up near sunset for the harbour and skyline in one view.

binnenhof.name: Binnenhof
binnenhof.price_text: Courtyard free; interior visits only with a tour — check on the day
binnenhof.hours: Outer courtyard open daily; renovation works ongoing — check on the day
binnenhof.tip: This is in The Hague, not Rotterdam — allow a half day for the train.

de_kuip.name: De Kuip
de_kuip.price_text: Stadium tour price varies — check on the day
de_kuip.hours: Tours on selected days; check the schedule
de_kuip.tip: Book a stadium tour ahead if you are a football fan; match days are busy.

tudelft.name: Delft University of Technology
tudelft.tip: It is in Delft, a short train ride away — combine it with the old town.

duinrell.name: Duinrell
duinrell.price_text: Day ticket varies by season — check on the day
duinrell.tip: It is a theme park plus water park near Wassenaar — plan a full day and check opening dates.

drievliet.name: Familiepark Drievliet
drievliet.price_text: Day ticket varies — check on the day
drievliet.tip: A family park in The Hague area, good for younger children.

pearl_earring.name: Girl With A Pearl Earring
pearl_earring.price_text: Included with Mauritshuis ticket — check on the day
pearl_earring.tip: The painting hangs in the Mauritshuis in The Hague — go early to see it without a crowd.

handelingenkamer.name: Handelingenkamer
handelingenkamer.price_text: Access depends on tours — check on the day
handelingenkamer.tip: The ornate library room is inside the Binnenhof complex in The Hague — check access before you go.

kinderdijk.name: Kinderdijk
kinderdijk.price_text: Visitor centre and mill entry have a fee — check on the day
kinderdijk.hours: Outdoor area always open; visitor centre daily hours vary
kinderdijk.tip: Rent a bike or take the waterbus from Rotterdam — the windmills are best in the morning light.

leiden_university.name: Leiden University
leiden_university.price_text: Free to walk the old centre
leiden_university.tip: It is in Leiden, a short train ride from Rotterdam — pair it with a canal walk.

madurodam.name: Madurodam
madurodam.price_text: Ticket varies — check on the day
madurodam.hours: Usually daily; hours vary by season
madurodam.tip: A miniature Netherlands park in The Hague — fun with kids, allow a couple of hours.

mauritshuis.name: Mauritshuis
mauritshuis.price_text: Ticket price varies — check on the day
mauritshuis.hours: Usually daily; check on the day
mauritshuis.tip: Book online in The Hague to skip the queue for the Dutch Golden Age collection.

new_church.name: New Church
new_church.price_text: Entry fee varies — check on the day
new_church.hours: Usually daily; check on the day
new_church.tip: It stands on The Hague's central square — check whether an exhibition is on before you pay.

peace_palace.name: Peace Palace
peace_palace.price_text: Exterior free; guided visits limited — check on the day
peace_palace.hours: Grounds viewable daily; tours by booking only
peace_palace.tip: You mostly see it from outside in The Hague — book a visitor tour well ahead if you want inside.

rotterdam_zoo.name: Rotterdam Zoo (Diergaarde Blijdorp)
rotterdam_zoo.price_text: Ticket varies — check on the day
rotterdam_zoo.hours: Usually daily; hours vary by season
rotterdam_zoo.tip: A large zoo next to Blijdorp station — allow half a day and check feeding times.

scheveningen_pier.name: Scheveningen Pier
scheveningen_pier.price_text: Free to walk the pier; attractions extra
scheveningen_pier.tip: A beach day in The Hague — walk the pier and check the ferris wheel separately.

speelstad.name: Speelstad Rotterdam (coming soon in 2025)
speelstad.price_text: Not yet open — check on the day
speelstad.tip: Announced for 2025 — confirm it is open before planning a visit.

witte_de_with.name: Witte de Withstraat
witte_de_with.price_text: Free to walk; food and drinks extra
witte_de_with.hours: Bars and restaurants usually from late afternoon into the night
witte_de_with.tip: Rotterdam's bar street — good for an evening walk and a drink.

watertaxi.name: Watertaxi across the Maas
watertaxi.price_text: Fare depends on route — check on the day
watertaxi.tip: A fast, cheap way to cross the river and see the skyline from the water.

harbour_tour.name: Rotterdam harbour boat tour
harbour_tour.price_text: Ticket varies — check on the day
harbour_tour.hours: Departures usually daily; check on the day
harbour_tour.tip: The port is huge — a boat tour shows the docks you cannot reach on foot.

kralingse_plas.name: Kralingse Plas
kralingse_plas.tip: A lake park for a walk or run away from the centre — bring a picnic.

delfshaven.name: Delfshaven
delfshaven.tip: An old harbour quarter that survived the war — walk the canal and small streets.

centraal_view.name: Rotterdam Centraal station roof view
centraal_view.tip: Step outside the station and look back at the pointed roof — a quick photo stop.
